about.title: About the Unified Minds set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Unified Minds is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 2 August 2019. It has 258 cards: 236 in the main set and 22 secret rares. There are also 196 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 236 main set cards), the Master set (432 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 454 cards, adding the 22 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
